title: Sliding-window rate limiter
trap: Fixed-window counters let a burst of 2x the limit through around the window edge, and rejected calls must not use up quota.
prompt: Add createLimiter({ limit, windowMs, now = Date.now }) to src/limiter.js. It returns an object with allow(key) that says whether a call for that key may go ahead: at most limit calls per key are allowed in any span of windowMs milliseconds. Use the now() function for the time so tests can control it. Add tests in test/limiter.test.js.
